Curated direct-dependency allowlist for the PaySwap monorepo (Work Order P3-W1-003).
Enforced by packages/web/test/dependency-audit.test.ts — the repository dependency surface is a CONTRACT:
any addition or removal in any workspace package.json fails the build with a diff.

ESCAPE HATCH (justified additions): a new dependency may be introduced ONLY by editing this
file in the SAME commit that adds it, with a one-line justification recorded under
"justifications" keyed as "<workspace>|<section>|<package>". Reviewers see both the diff
and the justification atomically. Removals need no justification but still require the
matching allowlist edit so the contract stays exact.

HARD LAW (no escape hatch): Resend and Apify SDKs (resend, @resend/*, apify, @apify/*,
apify-client) are ABSENT from every manifest and from the root lockfile. Re-introducing
them requires an explicit work-order amendment (Phase 3 law: absent unless an actual
workflow justifies them) — an allowlist edit can never authorize them.
